info.title: NEAR Intents Agent API
info.description:
Backend API for AI agents that trade on NEAR Intents under an owner-signed policy.

Authenticate with `X-API-Key`. Keep the key on your backend.

Owner actions use generate-intent → owner wallet signs `intent.payload` unchanged → submit-intent → GET /v1/status. Agent actions (swap, withdraw, transfer, …) need no owner signature, only `X-Grant-Token` for a live owner grant (who may act); the account policy decides what every grant may do, and return a `correlation_id` for GET /v1/status.

Errors are JSON:API documents. Every field, parameter and error code is snake_case. Branch on `errors[].code`, never on `title`. `UNCERTAIN` means the outcome is not yet proven: keep polling the same `correlation_id` and never resubmit under a new `Idempotency-Key`. `PENDING_DEPOSIT` is a deposit address waiting for funds; a withdrawal's bridge leg reads `PROCESSING`. `NEEDS_REVIEW` stops routine polling: inspect `details.reason`, never retry, then use `refresh=true` after provider/manual resolution.

post.summary: Generate an owner intent for signing
post.description: Builds the exact payload the owner's wallet must sign for one owner action and returns it as `intent: {standard, payload}`. Sign `intent.payload` unchanged with the wallet named by `standard`, then call submit-intent with the wallet's output. `agent_create` creates a pending agent and returns its id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical request. Replays with the same key and body return the original result; a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

post.description: Submits the wallet's signature over a generated intent. `signed_data.payload` must equal the generated payload. Resubmitting the same signature is idempotent. Returns the current status; poll GET /v1/status for settlement.

get.summary: Get the status of an intent or execution
get.description: Reads the status of any correlation id and reconciles it with chain and provider state. `wait_ms` stops at terminal, signature-needed or review-required status. `NEEDS_REVIEW` stops routine provider polling; after review, `refresh=true` explicitly observes the original request. It can also repair a historical failed execution's spend charge when the provider proves no funds moved.

get.summary: List an agent's intents and executions, newest first
get.description: Deposit addresses nothing was paid into, still open or already closed, are left out unless `include_unpaid=true`; read one by its `correlation_id` with `GET /v1/status`.

get.summary: Prove an execution's audit trail from the attested transparency log
get.description: Returns the retained audit events of one execution. A `PROVEN` event carries a `c2sp.org/tlog-proof@v1` inclusion proof; its evidence hashes to the opening's evidenceHash. The top-level checkpoint carries the log and notary signatures, bound to the notary's birth attestation. Send from_size from an independently trusted checkpoint and pass that checkpoint to verifyOperationProof: signatures alone do not reject a coordinated rollback. A server behind that checkpoint returns 409 transparency_checkpoint_behind. Consistency proves continuation from the trusted state, not response completeness or global freshness. A recent event reads PENDING until the next publication.

post.description: A live swap requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant, and the account policy must allow `swap`. With `dry: true` it returns a quote and needs only the API key: no grant and no `Idempotency-Key`. An archived, deleted or frozen account, or one whose applied policy does not parse (`policy_not_ready`), gets no quote. The spending rules never refuse a dry swap: each one a live swap would fail (schedule, USD budget, per-asset limits, actions per hour, or `policy_usage_unavailable` when unreconciled history keeps the limits from being judged) is listed in `warnings` under the live request's code, beside `spend` (USD value and budget left) and `fee`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical request. Replays with the same key and body return the original result; a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

post.summary: Withdraw an asset to an address on any supported chain
post.description: Both live withdrawals and `dry: true` previews require `X-Grant-Token`, `Idempotency-Key`, and an account policy allowing withdrawal to the destination. An archived, deleted or frozen account, or one whose applied policy does not parse (`policy_not_ready`), gets no preview. The spending rules never refuse one: it answers with `spend` (USD value and budget left), `fee` (the provider's estimate, when stated in the withdrawn asset) and `warnings`, which list each rule the live withdrawal would fail under its code (schedule, USD budget, per-asset limits, actions per hour, or `policy_usage_unavailable` when unreconciled history keeps the limits from being judged) beside `high_fee` (above 5%) and `asset_delivered_as_is` (a non-USDC asset to `hypercore`). Identical previews reuse a result for 60 seconds; an expired preview needs a new key. At most 20 provider preview attempts are admitted per agent per rolling 24 hours, including failed or uncertain attempts. NEAR (`nep141:wrap.near`, or `near`) withdrawn to chain `near` arrives as native NEAR; `wrapped: true` delivers wNEAR instead.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Get a deposit address that funds the agent from another chain
post.description: Requires an API key, not an owner grant. Creates a NEAR Intents 1Click deposit address that credits the agent's public or confidential balance, without spending agent funds or applying an execution delay. Send only `origin_asset` to fund the agent with any amount at or above `details.min_amount` until `details.expires_at`; add `amount` for an exact deposit. A failed or late deposit refunds into the agent's own balance (`details.refund_to`); no request field chooses a refund address. The status reads `PENDING_DEPOSIT` with `details.deposit_address` (and `details.memo` where the chain needs one) until funds arrive; without `amount` it stays open 3 days, and an address still unpaid a day after `details.expires_at` ends `FAILED` with `deposit_expired`. History lists an address only once something was paid into it. Funds go only to that address. `correlation_id` (`op_…`) is a tracking id and never an address.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical request. Replays with the same key and body return the original result; a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

post.summary: Dispatch an UNCERTAIN execution that provably never reached the provider
post.description: Only for executions with no provider reference and no dispatch commitment. `request` must equal the original body, `Idempotency-Key` the original key, and `X-Grant-Token` the token of the grant that admitted it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical request. Replays with the same key and body return the original result; a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

post.summary: Sign a NEP-413 message with the agent's NEAR key
post.description: Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant, and the account policy must list `recipient` in `native.near.sign_message`. Takes what a dApp's `signMessage({ message, recipient, nonce })` takes: `message` (the text to sign, `encoding` `hex` signs the UTF-8 text the bytes decode to), the relying party's base64 32-byte `nonce` and `recipient`. Returns `near_account_id`, `public_key` and the base64 `signature` over the NEP-413 payload, which the API checks before it answers. `callbackUrl` is not supported: the provider signs without one. The relying party must still check `nonce`, `recipient` and `public_key` (a full-access key of `near_account_id`, once that account exists on chain). The NEAR Intents contracts (`intents.near`, `intents.far`) are never recipients. Not delayed by `timelock_ms` or `schedule`. Recorded in history as type `native`, with the recipient.

post.summary: Send native NEAR from the agent's NEAR account
post.description: Needs `native.near.transfer`. Sends from the agent's NEAR account (`wallet.near_account_id`), outside NEAR Intents. Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`. OutLayer still applies the policy's `assets` (wNEAR covers native NEAR), `limits` and `max_actions_per_hour`. A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the same request and never sends twice.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical request. Replays with the same key and body return the original result; a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

post.summary: Call a NEAR contract from the agent's NEAR account
post.description: Needs `receiver_id` listed in `native.near.call`. The NEAR Intents contracts are never callable (`native_contract_forbidden`). Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`. Listing a token contract lets the agent send that token anywhere from its NEAR account. A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the same request and never calls twice.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical request. Replays with the same key and body return the original result; a different body is refused with `idempotency_conflict`.

post.summary: Sign EIP-712 typed data with the agent's EVM key
post.description: Needs the typed data's `domain` listed in `native.evm.sign_typed_data`: every field the domain carries (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract, salt) must match one listed entry exactly, and an extra or missing field is another domain. A listed entry with `primary_types` signs only those message types, so `primaryType` must be one of them; without it any message type is signed. That narrows the kind of message, never its fields: destinations and amounts inside the message are not checked. `types.EIP712Domain` may be omitted, and the API then derives it; when sent, it must declare exactly the domain's fields in EIP-712 order with their standard types, since the signed digest covers only declared fields. `message` is at most 65536 bytes as canonical JSON. The record (status and history, type `native`) carries `details.domain`, the matched domain, and `details.message_json`, the signed message as canonical JSON. Signs as `wallet.evm_account_id`, the same address on every EVM chain. Typed data can authorize transfers (EIP-3009) and approvals (EIP-2612 Permit) of anything that address holds. Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`.

post.summary: Sign an EIP-191 message with the agent's EVM key
post.description: Needs `native.evm.sign_message`. Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`.

post.summary: Sign a serialized EVM transaction with the agent's EVM key
post.description: Needs `native.evm.sign_transaction`, which gives full control of the EVM address. Nothing is broadcast; the caller sends the signed transaction. Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`.

post.summary: Sign an off-chain message with the agent's Solana key
post.description: Needs `native.solana.sign_message`. Signs as `wallet.solana_account_id`. Bytes that parse as a Solana transaction message are refused. Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`.

post.summary: Sign a Solana transaction message with the agent's Solana key
post.description: Needs `native.solana.sign_transaction`, which gives full control of the Solana address. Nothing is broadcast; the caller sends the signed transaction. Requires `X-Grant-Token` for a live grant and is refused while the agent is frozen; `destinations`, `budget`, `timelock_ms`, `schedule` and `owner_approval` do not apply. Recorded in history as type `native`.

get.summary: List the assets agents can hold and trade, with USD prices
get.description: Assets advertised by the wallet provider, with chain display hints and usable USD prices. Catalog presence does not guarantee support or availability for a particular route. `blockchain` preserves the existing market-chain, first-provider-chain, then near fallback; a fallback is not authoritative asset origin. `asset_id` is passed unchanged to executions. Public; the provider list is cached for 30 minutes, retained after refresh failure, and prices for one.

get.summary: Get the network, supported owner types and live dependency status
get.description: `status` reports 1Click, custody (OutLayer) and NEAR health from background probes, refreshed about once a minute. It is advisory: no request is refused because of it. Read it before acting, or after `quote_unavailable` / `provider_unavailable`, to tell a provider outage from a problem with the request.

get.summary: Identify the calling API key
Read effective partner resource quotas and usage

GrantToken.name: X-Grant-Token
GrantToken.description: Token of the owner grant a delegated request runs under. The partner creates it and the owner signs its commitment; keep it on your backend.
